headline: Budget update, 25 Mendon Street update, and a draft commercial loans delinquency policy.
summary: The agenda covers a financial information and budget update, a draft commercial loans delinquency policy, and 25 Mendon Street. It also includes executive sessions on the Las Delicias request, the Cape Verdean Museum request, and the Downtown Gateway update.
